name: anthropic-claude
label: Anthropic Claude
description: Anthropic Claude is a family of AI assistant models developed by Anthropic. This connector integrates FortiSOAR playbooks with Claude via the Anthropic Messages API, enabling AI-powered text generation, vision-based image analysis, multi-turn conversations, and token counting for cost management.

fields.title: API Key
fields.description: Specify the Anthropic API key used to authenticate API requests. You can generate an API key from your Anthropic Console. The key is stored securely in encrypted form.
fields.name: api_key
fields.tooltip: Specify the Anthropic API key used to authenticate API requests. You can generate an API key from your Anthropic Console. The key is stored securely in encrypted form.

fields.title: Default Model
fields.description: Select the Claude model that will be used by default when a model is not specified in an action.
fields.name: model
fields.tooltip: Opus 4.7: most capable. Sonnet 4.6 / 4.5: balanced performance. Haiku 4.5: fastest and most economical.

fields.title: Anthropic API Version
fields.description: Specify the Anthropic API version to use for requests. Leave the default value unless a different version is required by Anthropic.
fields.name: anthropic_version
fields.tooltip: Specify the Anthropic API version to use for requests. Leave the default value unless a different version is required by Anthropic.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Enable SSL certificate verification when connecting to the Anthropic API. Disable only if using a trusted proxy or self-signed certificates.
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Enable SSL certificate verification when connecting to the Anthropic API. Disable only if using a trusted proxy or self-signed certificates.

operations.title: Send Message
operations.description: Sends a prompt to the Anthropic Claude Messages API and returns the generated response. Supports optional system prompts, conversation history, model selection, temperature, token limits, stop sequences, and arbitrary additional request fields via Additional Parameters.

parameters.title: Prompt
parameters.description: The input prompt or question to send to Claude.
parameters.name: prompt
parameters.tooltip: Specify the message, question, or instructions that Claude should respond to.

parameters.title: System Prompt
parameters.description: Provides high-level instructions that guide Claude's behavior throughout the conversation.
parameters.name: system_prompt
parameters.tooltip: Use a system prompt to define Claude's role, response style, constraints, or task before processing the user prompt.

parameters.title: Model
parameters.description: Specifies the Claude model to use for generating the response.
parameters.name: model
parameters.tooltip: Select a model for this request. If left empty, the default model configured in the connector will be used.

parameters.title: Max Tokens
parameters.description: Limits the maximum number of tokens Claude can generate in the response.
parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum response length. Larger values allow longer responses but consume more tokens.

parameters.title: Temperature
parameters.description: Controls the randomness and creativity of the generated response.
parameters.name: temperature
parameters.tooltip: Use values between 0.0 and 1.0. Lower values produce more consistent responses, while higher values generate more diverse and creative output.

parameters.title: Stop Sequences
parameters.description: Defines one or more text sequences that cause Claude to stop generating output.
parameters.name: stop_sequences
parameters.tooltip: Provide one or more stop sequences, comma-separated (for example: "\n\nHuman:", "END"). Generation stops when any of these sequences is encountered. Useful for structured responses.

parameters.title: Conversation History
parameters.description: Supplies previous conversation messages to maintain context across multiple interactions.
parameters.name: conversation_history
parameters.tooltip: JSON array of prior messages, e.g. [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"},{"role":"assistant","content":"Hi!"}]. The current Prompt is appended automatically.

parameters.title: Additional Parameters
parameters.description: Optional JSON object of extra fields to include in the request payload (for example: top_p, top_k, metadata, tools, thinking, tool_choice, service_tier). Merged directly into the request body.
parameters.name: additional_params
parameters.tooltip: Provide a JSON object with any extra fields supported by the /v1/messages endpoint. Example: {"top_p": 0.9, "metadata": {"user_id": "u-123"}}. These fields are merged into the request payload.

operations.title: Chat with Image
operations.description: Analyze an image using Anthropic Claude by providing a prompt with either an image URL or base64-encoded image data. Use this operation to extract information, interpret diagrams, analyze screenshots, review documents, or answer questions about image content. Supports optional system prompts, model selection, temperature, token limits, and arbitrary additional request fields via Additional Parameters.

parameters.title: Prompt
parameters.description: The question or instruction describing what Claude should analyze in the image.
parameters.name: prompt
parameters.tooltip: Specify the question or instructions for Claude about the supplied image.

parameters.title: Image URL
parameters.description: Publicly accessible URL of the image to analyze.
parameters.name: image_url
parameters.tooltip: Provide a direct image URL. Specify either Image URL or Base64 Image Data.

parameters.title: Base64 Image Data
parameters.description: Base64-encoded image content for analysis.
parameters.name: image_base64
parameters.tooltip: Paste the Base64-encoded image. Specify either Base64 Image Data or Image URL.

parameters.title: Media Type
parameters.description: MIME type of the Base64-encoded image.
parameters.name: media_type
parameters.tooltip: Select the MIME type that matches the Base64 image being provided.

parameters.title: System Prompt
parameters.description: Instructions that define Claude's behavior while processing the request.
parameters.name: system_prompt
parameters.tooltip: Provide optional instructions to guide Claude's analysis, tone, or response style.

parameters.title: Model
parameters.description: Claude model used to process the request.
parameters.name: model
parameters.tooltip: Leave blank to use the default model configured for the connector.

parameters.title: Max Tokens
parameters.description: Maximum number of tokens Claude can generate in the response.
parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum response length. Larger values allow longer responses but consume more tokens.

parameters.title: Temperature
parameters.description: Controls the randomness of the generated response.
parameters.name: temperature
parameters.tooltip: Use lower values for consistent responses and higher values for more creative output. Leave empty to use the API default.

parameters.title: Additional Parameters
parameters.description: Optional JSON object of extra fields to include in the request payload (for example: stop_sequences, top_p, top_k, metadata, tools, thinking, tool_choice). Merged directly into the request body.
parameters.name: additional_params
parameters.tooltip: Provide a JSON object with any extra fields supported by the /v1/messages endpoint. Example: {"top_p": 0.9, "metadata": {"user_id": "u-123"}}. These fields are merged into the request payload.

operations.title: Count Tokens
operations.description: Calculate the number of input tokens for a prompt before sending it to the Anthropic API. This helps estimate token usage, manage costs, and ensure requests remain within the selected model's context window. Supports system prompts, conversation history, and arbitrary additional request fields via Additional Parameters.

parameters.title: Prompt
parameters.description: The primary message or input text for which the token count should be calculated.
parameters.name: prompt
parameters.tooltip: Enter the text you plan to send to Claude. The connector calculates the number of input tokens required for this prompt.

parameters.title: System Prompt
parameters.description: Optional instructions that define Claude's behavior or response style. Included when calculating the total input token count.
parameters.name: system_prompt
parameters.tooltip: Provide system-level instructions if they will be included in the request. This ensures the token count reflects the complete API payload.

parameters.title: Model
parameters.description: The Claude model to use for token calculation. If omitted, the connector's default model is used.
parameters.name: model
parameters.tooltip: Select the Claude model that will process the request so the token count matches the target model's tokenizer.

parameters.title: Conversation History
parameters.description: Optional JSON array containing previous user and assistant messages to include in the token calculation.
parameters.name: conversation_history
parameters.tooltip: Provide prior conversation messages in JSON format to calculate the total tokens for a multi-turn conversation, including the current prompt.

parameters.title: Additional Parameters
parameters.description: Optional JSON object of extra fields to include in the count_tokens request payload (for example: tools, thinking, tool_choice, cache_control, output_config). Merged directly into the request body.
parameters.name: additional_params
parameters.tooltip: Provide a JSON object with any extra fields supported by the /v1/messages/count_tokens endpoint. Example: {"tools": [{"name": "get_weather", "description": "...", "input_schema": {...}}]}. These fields are merged into the request payload.

operations.title: List Models
operations.description: Retrieve the Claude models available for the configured Anthropic API key, including each model's identifier, display name, and creation date. Supports pagination via limit, before_id, and after_id.

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of models to return (1-1000). Leave empty to use the API default of 20.
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of models to return per request. Valid range: 1-1000.

parameters.title: Before ID
parameters.description: Cursor for backwards pagination. Returns the page of results immediately before the specified model ID.
parameters.name: before_id
parameters.tooltip: Provide a model ID to fetch the page of models that ends just before it. Cannot be combined with After ID.

parameters.title: After ID
parameters.description: Cursor for forwards pagination. Returns the page of results immediately after the specified model ID.
parameters.name: after_id
parameters.tooltip: Provide a model ID to fetch the page of models that starts just after it. Cannot be combined with Before ID.

operations.title: Execute API Request
operations.description: Send an arbitrary HTTP request to any Anthropic API endpoint. Use this advanced operation to call endpoints and HTTP methods not covered by the other operations (for example, message batches, files, or beta endpoints).

parameters.title: HTTP Method
parameters.description: HTTP method to use for the request.
parameters.name: method
parameters.tooltip: Select the HTTP method. GET and DELETE ignore any Request Payload.

parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.description: API endpoint path, beginning with a forward slash (for example, /v1/messages).
parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Provide the endpoint path relative to the Anthropic API base (https://api.anthropic.com). For example: /v1/messages, /v1/files, /v1/messages/batches.

parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.description: Optional JSON object of query string parameters to append to the request URL.
parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.tooltip: Provide a JSON object whose key-value pairs become query parameters. Example: {"limit": 20, "before_id": "claude-haiku-4-5"}. Values are URL-encoded automatically.

parameters.title: Request Payload
parameters.description: Optional JSON object sent as the request body. Ignored for GET and DELETE.
parameters.name: payload
parameters.tooltip: Provide a JSON object that becomes the request body. Must be a JSON object (not an array or scalar). Ignored when HTTP Method is GET or DELETE.
